generated.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent bitmap sprite atlas for a Pokémon tower-battle game, in polished Nintendo DS era pixel-art style. Create a perfectly aligned grid of SIX separate sprites, TWO columns and THREE rows, with generous transparent empty margins in each equal-size cell. Front-facing three-quarter overhead camera, consistent lighting and scale, crisp pixel clusters with attractive detailed roof tiles and stonework. Row 1: two small gym lookout towers, left with blue accents and right with warm red accents. Row 2: two larger royal gym towers, left blue, right red. Row 3: two low square stone deployment bastions, left blue, right red. All six sprites must be fully visible and separated, on a transparent background. Small towers have cream stone walls, a substantial stone footing, a flat open rooftop lookout deck for a Pokémon to stand on, a tasteful Pokéball crest on the front and short blue or red pennants. Royal towers are wider and sturdier with an elevated open rooftop deck, a larger Pokéball crest and two short banners. No characters, Pokémon, lettering, numbers, health bars, card frames or surrounding scene. Design actual beautiful finished game buildings, with coherent perspective and clean silhouettes. No vector appearance, no simple stacked rectangles, no blurry glows, no noisy texture. Keep each building centered within its cell with feet resting near the same relative baseline.
